verdict.rationale: The only direct lineage evidence is a single marketing line about "lineage-aware pipeline runs" in dltHub orchestration. Adjacent capabilities support it only indirectly: runs are logged and auditable, monitoring is available in the Web UI, and pipelines can be chained. Missing for 10: any documented lineage view or graph showing which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table, column- or table-level lineage tracking across dlt and dbt, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
